conditions.surface: Owner-authorized server housing/city snapshot projection only; never changes real world blocks or native gameplay state.

conditions.resource_selector: Native/mod ore tags ores,ore,ores/*,*_ores; explicit ore registry-ID families *_ore,ore_*; minecraft:ancient_debris. Player-built storage blocks and other nonresource blocks stay original.

conditions.acceptance: Source repair; production parent build/sync and in-game user acceptance still pending.

change.summary: Keep opaque subsurface geometry solid while masking ore/resource states as nearest locally observed ordinary host stone before any snapshot palette or tooltip facts exist.

modifiers.before: SnapshotVisibility.disclose drops every enclosed block and rejects hidden ores; omitted blocks become void in detached isometry. Existing visible ore ray contract can expose original ore IDs in snapshots.
modifiers.after: Projection preserves actual nonair nonresource states. All recognized ore/resource states in snapshots, even physically visible ores, become ordinary nearby host rock selected deterministically by squared distance within radius3 from loaded chunks. No original state ID/tag/name/Counted/amenity facts or ore-mask marker is transmitted.

Shared cache per snapshot job,4096 additional host world reads/job; global256host reads/server tick across housing+city calls. Search skips unavailable chunks, air, liquids, block entities, resources and nonfull collision shapes. Common native/Forge stone tags preserve modded hosts; exact installed Alexs Caves natural rock IDs cover missing common tags. If no eligible host is observed in bounded loaded context, use native dimension host (netherrack/endstone; otherwise deepslate below0 or stone). No forced chunks or world writes.

modifiers.before: At most1800 sampled top columns and4vertical cells, with enclosed cells then removed; no solid subsurface band.
modifiers.after: At most450sampledcolumns with16cells from actual surface downward,32columns/server tick; base<=7200cells plus<=512observeddecor positions remains below8192. Air remains real air; this is bounded foundation LOD, not whole-world underground dumping.

rationale.purpose: User requires ores to look like nearby ordinary rock rather than holes, while preserving non-disclosure before network/render/filter construction.
rationale.decision_source: User follow-up2026-10-18 reports empty bottom of isometries after ore hiding and explicitly requests nearest surrounding stone/deepslate/modded rock replacement.
rationale.user_requested: Replace hidden ores with nearest ordinary surrounding rock; no empty air at ore coordinates; preserve mod rocks.
rationale.codex_choices: Server state projection, uniform resource masking including exposed ores, radius3 deterministic nearest observed host,4096job/global256tick host read bounds, dimension fallback when bounded context unknown;16cell/450column city foundation to stay inside existing8192packet/render ceiling.

introduced.summary: Replace snapshot culling with bounded nearest-local-host projection before palette/facts; preserve solid house floor and city16cell foundation band. User acceptance pending.

history.summary: Replace snapshot culling with bounded nearest-local-host projection before palette/facts; preserve solid house floor and city16cell foundation band. User acceptance pending.

relations: actual world BlockState -> server projected nonresource BlockState -> palette+geometry -> detached renderer
only unchanged-original nonresource states -> amenity/contribution facts; projected rock never reveals raw ore metadata
notes: No client masking fallback and no changes to saved world blocks, drops, registries, recipes or actual city scoring.

Static Atlas evidence queried native iron/gold/diamond/coal/deepslate ore/stone plus installed Alexs Caves host tags. Correct actual uranium ID is alexscaves:radrock_uranium_ore, not guessed alexscaves:uranium_ore.
Native base-stone/ore-replaceable tags and forge:stone/c:stones cover installed ordinary mod rocks; exact tagless Alexs Caves guanostone/coprolith/abyssmarine are natural host candidates.

Ordinary real underground cavities remain air. Unobserved/unloaded context or exhausted lookup budget can require native fallback; no claim to identify unregistered/untagged/non-ore-named resource semantics automatically.
Client city LOD clips final sampled X/Z footprints to authoritative MaxX/MaxZ bounds instead of extending stride past territory.
unresolved: Production build/artifact delivery belongs to parent; no screenshot/gameplay acceptance conducted.
Host search is nearest among bounded observed radius3 candidates; dimensions with unknown custom host and no tagged/known rock use conservative native stone/deepslate fallback.
